ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a predominant low-intensity base (approx. 70-80% dark grey/black pixels) and high-intensity white speckling/mottling occupying the remaining surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel clusters are concentrated heavily at the distal tips of both lobes and along the trailing edge margins. Fine-grained white mottling is dispersed across the central dark-pigmented regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central notch with a distinct vertex and symmetrical divergence of the lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes are visible along the entire trailing edge, appearing particularly jagged and pronounced at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward and outward sweep characterized by a concave curvature along the trailing edge, terminating in sharply defined distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, localized clusters of high-intensity white pixels resembling circular colonies are visible at the furthest distal points and along the immediate trailing edge of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters at the lobe tips consistent with barnacle colonization or related scarring; no macro-scale physical trauma or amputations are visible in the current resolution.
other_distinctive_markers: The fluke is surrounded by multiple secondary subjects (pinnipeds) visible as low-contrast dark shapes breaking the water surface in the foreground and mid-ground.
